name: Notifications
author: dbarke
description: A standing bell in the bar: what arrived while you were looking elsewhere, replayable as toasts, with do-not-disturb one right-click away.

barWidget.description: Counts the notifications that expired unseen, lists them in the panel, and makes silencing visible instead of silent.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: A backstop only. The count already updates the moment a toast expires into history, so polling harder buys nothing.

schema.label: Show the count
schema.description: Off leaves just the bell, which still changes shape when something is waiting.

schema.label: Hide when there is nothing to say
schema.description: Collapses the widget entirely while nothing is unseen and notifications are not silenced. Silenced always stays visible -- a hidden mute is how you miss a day of messages.

schema.label: Body text limit (characters)
schema.description: How much of each notification body the panel shows before eliding. 0 shows titles only.

schema.label: Ignore notifications matching
schema.description: Comma-separated text, matched case-insensitively against each notification's app name and title. Matches are dropped before anything is counted or listed. The default filters Omarchy's own screenshot confirmation -- you pressed the key, so it was never missed. Empty keeps everything.
